input: observed 1-5 train ratings only; validation ratings for selection only; no test rating access; no recipe attributes
prediction: training global mean + user bias + recipe bias + user-vector dot recipe-vector
loss: mean squared error on observed training entries + lambda times mean squared norms of the indexed user/recipe factors and biases; missing entries are not negatives
selection: highest mean validation NDCG@10 among users with at least one positive validation rating; ties use lower clipped validation RMSE, fewer factors, greater regularization, earlier epoch
ranking: all 75972 cohort recipes minus each user's 28 training-rated recipes; trained recipes by unbounded MF score descending, ties by numeric recipe ID; recipes with no training rating follow as unscorable fallback by training positive count then numeric recipe ID
validation_relevance: ratings 4-5 positive for Precision; gains 0,0,0,1,2 for NDCG
boundary: retrospective supplementary baseline added after original four-condition test work; validation-tuned and test-blind implementation, not a preregistered fifth primary condition
references: Forbes and Zhu, Content-boosted Matrix Factorization for Recommender Systems: Experiments with Recipe Recommendation, RecSys 2011
Mahajan and Kaur, A Systematic Literature Review of Food Recommender Systems, SN Computer Science 2024
